entities.summary: Luis Enrique Cessa is a Mexican professional baseball pitcher for the Olmecas de Tabasco of the Mexican League. He has previously played in Major League Baseball (MLB) for the New York Yankees and Cincinnati Reds. He made his MLB debut in 2016.
